definitions.verified_now: Traceable to working product, working marketing-repository code, or approved evidence within the stated scope.
definitions.in_development: Under development; completeness and future availability are not implied.
definitions.planned_for_evaluation: A research or pilot pathway being prepared; approval, completion and findings are not implied.
definitions.not_claimed: Withheld because evidence is unavailable, insufficient, unapproved or outside the audited scope.
